issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. It stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the atelier regulator at all, and nothing ties its stopping to the death or to any clock reading.
issues.misreading: 'It stopped with its master' implies the regulator stopped at the moment of Aurèle's death. A solver could take that as a stopped reading that marks the time of death, or as a sign that the death happened around the time the regulator stopped. The sheet supports neither link, so this is a hint about the time of death that the facts do not give.
